name: Sample Full Test 02
description: A 4-section test — Physics, Chemistry, Botany and Zoology — to show that tests are not limited to three sections.

questions.question: The SI unit of magnetic flux is:
questions.explanation: Magnetic flux Φ = B·A, measured in weber (1 Wb = 1 T·m²).

questions.question: Two resistors of 6 Ω and 3 Ω are connected in parallel. The equivalent resistance is:
The escape velocity from the Earth's surface is approximately:
A convex lens of focal length 10 cm forms an image at 20 cm. The object distance is (in cm):
questions.explanation: 1/v − 1/u = 1/f with v = 20 and f = 10 gives u = −20 cm, i.e. an object distance of 20 cm.

questions.question: Which plant hormone promotes cell elongation?

questions.explanation: Turgor changes in the guard cells alter the size of the stomatal pore.

questions.explanation: Pepsinogen is converted to pepsin by HCl in the stomach and hydrolyses proteins to peptides.

questions.explanation: Platelets (thrombocytes) release clotting factors that trigger the coagulation cascade.
